stem: If two liquids A and B form minimum boiling azeotrope at some specific composition then ____________.
options: A–B interactions are stronger than those between A–A or B–B.
vapour pressure of solution increases because more number of molecules of liquids A and B can escape from the solution.
vapour pressure of solution decreases because less number of molecules of only one of the liquids escape from the solution.
A–B interactions are weaker than those between A–A or B–B.

checks.notes: Key (i) A-B stronger is wrong: minimum boiling azeotrope arises from positive deviation, i.e. weaker A-B interactions (option iv). Transcription and key reading verified.
